fields.name: live_battle_state
fields.meaning: Live battle state while a map is played (turn counter, sides, unit table). Not itself the save: the save routine copies this whole block to 0x6200 and loading copies it back.
fields.evidence: code e000:cb17 (copy to 0x6200) / e000:cbab (copy back); new-game diff fills it; 5 settled saves have 0x0000-0x0FFF == 0x6200-0x71FF byte for byte

fields.name: unknown
fields.meaning: Unknown; zero in every save seen.
fields.evidence: save-image diffs

fields.name: live_battle_state_2
fields.meaning: Second live battle work block (enemy-phase AI/move data), copied to 0x7200 by the save routine and back on load. Empty before the first enemy phase, filled after it.
fields.evidence: code e000:cb17/e000:cbab; natural-save diff (empty at turn 40, filled at turn 39)

fields.name: unknown
fields.meaning: Unknown; zero in every save seen.
fields.evidence: save-image diffs

fields.name: map_work_data
fields.meaning: Map working data written when a scenario map is set up; not copied by the save routine (rebuilt when the battle is resumed).
fields.evidence: map-setup diff; absent from save routine e000:cb17

fields.name: unknown
fields.meaning: Unknown; zero in every save seen.
fields.evidence: save-image diffs

fields.name: resume_magic
fields.meaning: Resume-save marker, the text 'ｺﾝﾃｨﾆｭｰ･OK' (Continue OK). Written last by the save routine, so a save interrupted part-way is not offered. The title-screen Continue option checks these 10 bytes; if they do not match, Continue does nothing.
fields.evidence: code e000:cb8d (write from ROM e000:cba1) and e000:cafd (check at e000:cb02); caller 4000:c4f1 (title menu, Continue is cursor index 2)

fields.name: unused
fields.meaning: Not written by the save routine; zero.
fields.evidence: code e000:cb17

fields.name: resume_screen
fields.meaning: Game-state number to jump to after loading. Set to 2 when the map menu confirms an item, saved from work RAM 0x06F0, restored as the current game state on load. Value 2 in all natural saves.
fields.evidence: code e000:cb25 (write from RAM 0x06F0) / e000:cbb9 (load to 0x0602); f000:8860 sets RAM 0x06F0 = 2

fields.name: unused
fields.meaning: Not written by the save routine; zero.
fields.evidence: code e000:cb17

fields.name: campaign_misc_6c2
fields.meaning: Copy of work RAM 0x06C2-0x06C3; meaning unknown (zero in all saves).
fields.evidence: code e000:cb2b

fields.name: game_mode
fields.meaning: Copy of work RAM 0x06C4: play mode selector (0 = story scenario path).
fields.evidence: code f000:4a2e switch on 0x06C4; 0 in all saves

fields.name: game_submode
fields.meaning: Copy of work RAM 0x06C5: sub-mode used when mode is not 0.
fields.evidence: code f000:4a13 second switch

fields.name: scenario_number
fields.meaning: Copy of work RAM 0x06C6: current scenario number (0 = first scenario). Picks the turn limit and starting funds from ROM tables at scenario start.
fields.evidence: code f000:7468 (turn-limit table), f000:7482 (funds table), f000:448a (sets from select 0x065A); 0 with first-scenario title card

fields.name: scenario_phase
fields.meaning: Copy of work RAM 0x06C7: scenario progress step (1 = before map, 2 = map in progress).
fields.evidence: code f000:448a sets 1, f000:4a4f sets 2; 2 in all saves

fields.name: campaign_misc_6c8
fields.meaning: Copy of work RAM 0x06C8-0x06CF: small campaign counters (0x06CE is the index of the 17-entry record list at 0x7DB8); all zero here.
fields.evidence: code e000:cb2b; 4000:bf10 clears them; f000:ed70 uses 0x06CE

fields.name: side_enable_6d0
fields.meaning: Copy of work RAM 0x06D0-0x06D1: per-side enable flags tested by the income routine (byte [side] must be nonzero outside story mode).
fields.evidence: code f000:760a; zero in story-mode saves

fields.name: funds_side0
fields.meaning: War funds (軍資金) of side 0 divided by 100: 20 = 2000, 30 = 3000, 40 = 4000 across three natural saves. Capped at 9999.
fields.evidence: natural-save diffs with matching screen funds; code f000:7482 (ROM init 10), f000:763f (income +10/+5, clamp 0x270F)

fields.name: funds_side1
fields.meaning: War funds of side 1 divided by 100 (50 -> 60 -> 70 across three saves, same +10 income as side 0). Same per-side array as side 0, initialized from the same ROM table row.
fields.evidence: code f000:75f9 indexes [side*2+0x06D2]; ROM init 50; enemy '+' structure owned by side 1

fields.name: funds_side2
fields.meaning: War funds of side 2 (third array slot). Zero; no third side on these maps.
fields.evidence: code f000:75f9 array shape; ROM init 0

fields.name: unknown_6d8
fields.meaning: Copy of work RAM 0x06D8-0x06DF: four words that change every round; word 0 always equals word 2 (8/8 then 56/56). Possibly cursor/camera positions.
fields.evidence: natural-save diffs

fields.name: unknown_6e0
fields.meaning: Copy of work RAM 0x06E0-0x06EF; zero in all saves.
fields.evidence: code e000:cb2b

fields.name: unused
fields.meaning: Not written by the save routine; zero.
fields.evidence: code e000:cb17

fields.name: table_700
fields.meaning: Copy of work RAM 0x0700-0x077D: an 8-entry table of 16-byte records searched by an id word at +8; zero in all saves.
fields.evidence: code e000:cb3e; record search loop near e000:c900

fields.name: unused
fields.meaning: Not written by the save routine; zero.
fields.evidence: code e000:cb17

fields.name: screen_objects
fields.meaning: Copy of work RAM 0x0C00-0x0D7F: on-screen object table, 24 sprite records of 16 bytes (screen coordinates, tile, attributes); the map cursor position word lives at +0x22.
fields.evidence: code e000:cb51; f000:ebd9 writes cursor to 0x0C22; title init 4000:c064

fields.name: unknown_0d80
fields.meaning: Copy of work RAM 0x0D80-0x0D83; unknown.
fields.evidence: code e000:cb51

fields.name: income_structures
fields.meaning: Copy of work RAM 0x0D84-0x0DF3: 7 income structures of 16 bytes. Byte +0 is the type ('+' pays 10 funds, '-' pays 5, 0 unused), byte +5 is the owner side, bytes +8..+11 index counters in live SRAM 0x01D7. In the natural saves each side owns one '+' structure, hence +10 funds per side per round.
fields.evidence: code f000:75f9 (type test, owner match, pay, clamp); two '+' records owned by sides 0 and 1

fields.name: income_record7_trunc
fields.meaning: Eighth income structure WITHOUT its last 4 bytes: RAM 0x0E00-0x0E03 falls past the 0x200-byte copy window so it is never saved (type/owner/counters survive; only the unknown tail is lost). Quirk, harmless here since record 7 is unused.
fields.evidence: code e000:cb51 loop bound 0x200 vs table end 0x0E04

fields.name: battle_state_head
fields.meaning: Start of the copy of live battle block 0x0000-0x0FFF (offset 0x6200+x holds live byte x). All zero in every save seen.
fields.evidence: code e000:cb65

fields.name: current_side
fields.meaning: Index of the side (army) whose turn it is.
fields.evidence: code f000:83f7 (end-of-turn routine increments it, wraps at side count)

fields.name: side_count
fields.meaning: Number of sides taking turns on this map (2).
fields.evidence: code f000:83f7

fields.name: unknown
fields.meaning: Unknown; zero.

fields.name: turns_left
fields.meaning: Turns remaining on this map (shown as ターン): 40, then 39, then 38 across three natural saves.
fields.evidence: natural-save diffs with matching screen count; code f000:747b sets it from a ROM table by scenario number, f000:8407 decrements it when all sides have moved

fields.name: unknown
fields.meaning: Unknown.

fields.name: side_unit_ranges
fields.meaning: Unit-number boundary list: side n owns unit records from byte n up to byte n+1 (0x00,0x10,0x20 here: 16 units per side).
fields.evidence: code f000:83f7 reads 0x0215+side

fields.name: unknown
fields.meaning: Unknown.

fields.name: campaign_live_mirror
fields.meaning: Live SRAM 0x0300-0x03FF (also the source the between-scenario save snapshots to 0x7C00). All zero during battle in every save seen.

fields.name: deploy_list
fields.meaning: Live 0x0400-0x05FF: list of 4-byte entries (unit-type word + 2 position bytes) filled from ROM data when the map is set up; also the source of the between-scenario word lists.
fields.evidence: code f000:7458 writes 0x0402+4n from a ROM list; new-game diff

fields.name: unit_records
fields.meaning: Live 0x0600-0x0FFF: unit records, 16 bytes each (160 slots). Byte +0 is 0 for deployed units and 1 for empty slots; byte +2 bit 7 is kept and the low bits (has-acted flags) are cleared for a side at its turn start; word +5 holds a value like 3000 or 2000 (likely hit points).
fields.evidence: code f000:83f7 (clears +2 per side); new-game and per-round diffs

fields.name: battle_state_2
fields.meaning: Copy of live block 0x1800-0x20FF (see above). Filled after an enemy phase.
fields.evidence: code e000:cb78; natural-save diff

fields.name: unused
fields.meaning: Not written by either save routine; zero.
fields.evidence: code e000:cb17, e000:ca68

fields.name: best_scenario
fields.meaning: Highest scenario number recorded in the between-scenario save. Read at power-on into RAM 0x07AC.
fields.evidence: code e000:ca68 (keeps the max of work RAM 0x06C6), 4000:bf10 copies it to 0x07AC

fields.name: campaign_table
fields.meaning: Between-scenario save: snapshot of live SRAM 0x0300-0x03FF. Zero here (no scenario finished yet).
fields.evidence: code e000:ca68 (save), e000:cabf (load)

fields.name: load_scenario
fields.meaning: Between-scenario save: scenario number to continue from; nonzero means a scenario save exists.
fields.evidence: code e000:ca68 (write from 0x06C6), f000:4a86 (checks nonzero then loads)

fields.name: campaign_words
fields.meaning: Between-scenario save: 90 words copied from live SRAM 0x0405 stepping 4 bytes (the deploy-list area).
fields.evidence: code e000:caa4 (ES = SRAM throughout)

fields.name: unlock_flags
fields.meaning: 17 on/off flags (bit n of byte n/8) gating the entries of a 17-item list menu. Set to 0x03 (first two on) when the memory is first formatted.
fields.evidence: code e000:c990 (init 3), f000:2ffb bit test called 17 times from 4000:caa0; format diff

fields.name: entry_records
fields.meaning: 17 variable-length records (byte offsets 0x00..0x1C8 from a ROM table), one per list entry; filled from live SRAM 0x0405 words after a stage in non-story modes. Zero here.
fields.evidence: code e000:c9c9 (write), e000:c99b (clear), offset table ROM e000:c9ff

fields.name: unused
fields.meaning: Not written; zero.
fields.evidence: save-image diffs

fields.name: format_signature
fields.meaning: Format marker 'SDｶﾞﾝﾀﾞﾑ･ｴﾓｰｼｮﾅﾙｼﾞｬﾑ' (SD Gundam Emotional Jam). Checked at power-on; if it does not match, the whole 32 KB is cleared, the marker is written and the unlock flags reset to 0x03.
fields.evidence: code e000:c920 (check) / e000:c960 (format); format diff; only the pre-format image lacks it (1 of 152)

fields.name: not_used
fields.meaning: Not used by this game; byte-identical in blank and saved states (console data only).
fields.evidence: all 152 EEPROM images identical

values.value: byte-identical in blank and saved states; game writes nothing here
: no checksums in this format; verified structure, copied unchanged.
